user_query: I'm organizing a company event and I need to send out invitations to all our clients. Can you provide me with a template for the email invitation from CakeMail API? Additionally, I would like to include some interesting environmental facts from Revista Verde API in the email to raise awareness about sustainability.

TaskList.description: Retrieve a template for the email invitation from the CakeMail API.
Fetch interesting environmental facts from the Revista Verde API.
Compose the email using the template and the fetched environmental facts.
Send out the composed email invitation to all clients through the CakeMail API.
